**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement satisfies the **preferred** position under MINCOMMIT — no minimum purchase commitment on Customer:

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," with pay-for-what-you-order language and an express statement that declining to place further orders "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars Vendor from imposing any "minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** — Vendor affirmatively acknowledges Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment.
- **§ 8.2 (p0035)** — each Order Form renews in twelve-month increments subject to a unilateral 30-day non-renewal right, so even the renewal mechanic carries a clean exit rather than a ratchet.

The "shortfall" references in **§ 22 (p0095–p0096)** relate to a licence-audit true-up for usage exceeding entitlements — a true-up, not a take-or-pay penalty — and so fall outside this rule.
